name: data-tables-handler
description: Processes overlay-related CSV data table uploads to Parquet + column stats on R2. Uses @duckdb/node-api (not legacy duckdb). Installed with the root npm workspace. The Docker image builds this package from that workspace.

scripts.test: tsx --test src/validateJoinColumn.test.ts src/deriveWhenColumns.test.ts src/applyNodataValues.test.ts src/normalizeCsvEncoding.test.ts src/inferCsvColumnPlans.test.ts src/enrichOrganisms.test.ts src/taxonomyApis.test.ts src/wikidataCrosswalk.test.ts src/remotes.test.ts src/wormsParquet.test.ts src/clusterParquet.test.ts
